User.title: User Profile
User.description: Represents a user in the system, who can be a rider, driver, or admin.

uid.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching Firebase Auth UID.

role.description: The role of the user within the system.

governorate.description: The governorate the user belongs to for ad targeting.

district.description: The district the user belongs to for ad targeting.

status.description: The current status of a driver.

gridId.description: The geospatial grid ID for location-based queries.

ratingSum.description: The sum of all ratings received by the user.

ratingCount.description: The total number of ratings received.

heartCount.description: The total number of 'favorite' hearts a driver has received.

penaltyCount.description: Number of times a driver has been penalized for ghosting or violations.

isRatingRequired.description: Flag indicating if a rider must rate their last trip before requesting a new one.

favoriteDrivers.description: A rider's list of favorite driver UIDs.

fcmTokens.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging tokens for push notifications.

deviceId.description: A unique identifier for the user's device to prevent Sybil attacks.

silencePreference.description: The driver's preference for conversation during a trip.

Trip.title: Trip Request
Trip.description: Represents a ride request made by a rider.

pickup.description: The Google Maps URL for the pickup location.

isRatedByRider.description: True if the rider has submitted their feedback for this trip.

isRatedByDriver.description: True if the driver has submitted their feedback for this trip.

gridId.description: The geospatial grid ID for matching.

expiresAt.description: Timestamp for when the request expires.

offerPrice.description: The final price offered by the driver for this trip.

iteration_count.description: The number of rotation cycles a searching trip has been through.

auditLog.description: A log of significant events in the trip lifecycle.

rejectedDrivers.description: A list of driver UIDs who have been rejected or have timed out for this trip.

ghostBusterStartLocation.description: The driver's location at the moment they accepted the trip, for ghosting detection.

/trips/{tripId}.description: Stores all trip requests and their lifecycle states.
